findings.shapeHypothesis: refuted: re-sending the string system message as a text block left the shortfall unchanged

verificationAdjustments.change: Waits for 'fresh query setup, isReentrant=false, activeContexts>=1' instead of the cross-session 'treated as reentrant' marker that 01 removed by design; completion, Agent handler and stuck-marker assertions unchanged.

verificationAdjustments.evidence: GNU timeout is absent on this macOS host; the shell tests exited 127.
verificationAdjustments.change: Only when the host lacks timeout, the shell steps get a PATH shim that runs the command in its own process group, sends TERM after the duration and exits 124.

The capture proxy forwards a body replaced by beforeForward; an optional transformPayload drives the diagnostic arm; message shapes are shared and also recorded for real Pi processes. Production src unchanged.

handoff: All three children are closed. 02's zero-shortfall target is not met and is recorded as an accepted external limit by user decision; a Claude Code or SDK change should re-run 08-cache-tail-origin and this review.

addendum.decision: Cache checks are optional. They leave the full run (verify --all, test) and run only as a separate cache test (verify --cache, test:cache).
changes: 06-rebuild-cache, 06-native-resume-control and 08-cache-tail-origin carry group cache; verify --all skips them, verify --cache selects only them, an explicit name still runs one; --cache cannot be combined with --all, --list or names.
06-restart-continuity judges the branch-link contract, new CC UUID, unchanged source and preserved content; the cache shortfall stays in its observation only.
int-cache.sh left the test script and the final integration runner's default set; test:cache and the runner's --cache mode run it.
App AGENTS.md, README and CHANGELOG document the optional cache test, its cost and the meaning of its expected failures.
